# Frontend UI & PDF Export Quality Checklist: 004-risk-analytics-trust

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness and clarity of requirements relating to the frontend user interface, comparison charts, and the client-side PDF export feature.
**Created**: 2026-10-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness
- [x] CHK001 Are exact margins, pagination boundaries, and font sizes specified for the PDF export layout (e.g. A4 vs US Letter)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK002 Are branding element dimensions (logos, disclaimers) strictly defined for the advisor session PDF? [Completeness, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK003 Are loading skeleton states defined for the risk panels while the Monte Carlo simulation runs? [Completeness, Gap]

## Requirement Clarity
- [x] CHK004 Is "one-click" generation strictly defined (i.e., clarifying whether intermediate confirmation dialogs are allowed or prohibited)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK005 Are the exact dimensions and tooltip behaviors of the representative single-path inspection chart specified? [Clarity, Gap]
- [x] CHK006 Is the specific charting library (e.g., Chart.js, Recharts) mandated or constrained by requirements? [Clarity, Plan]

## Requirement Consistency
- [x] CHK007 Do the visual style and layout requirements of the interactive web risk panels perfectly align with the static exported PDF risk panels? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK008 Are typography and color scale requirements consistent between the primary application theme and the generated PDF? [Consistency]

## Failure Recovery & Edge Cases
- [x] CHK009 Are fallback UI requirements specified if `html2canvas` fails to render a complex WebGL/Canvas chart? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK010 Are UI state requirements and error messages defined if the user's browser runs out of memory during PDF generation? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK011 Are visual degradation paths defined for unsupported or older mobile browsers when attempting client-side PDF export? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK012 Are requirements specified for when a user attempts to export a PDF before all extraction provenance flags are confirmed? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009]

## Measurability
- [x] CHK013 Can the "Dynamic & Visually Stunning" 60fps rendering requirement be objectively measured during the comparison chart transitions? [Measurability, Constitution §III]
